title: Speculative Forking: Turning Idle Wait into Parallel Exploration for Repository Environment Setup
abstract: arXiv:2610.33129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Before developers can use a software project, they must first get it to run. This often requires installing the right language runtime, system packages, build tools, and test commands. Recent LLM-based agents automate environment setup by inspecting a repository, writing setup scripts, running them, and repairing the resulting errors. However, these agents still follow a sequential trial-and-error loop: they try one setup route, wait for slow commands to finish, observe the failure, and only then decide what to try next. Because environment commands often take long to run, this sequential workflow makes setup slow and limits exploration to one route at a time.   We present SpecBuild, an LLM-based environment setup system designed to be both faster and more successful through speculative forking. translated_title: 投机分叉：将闲置等待转化为代码仓库环境搭建中的并行探索
translated_abstract: 在开发人员能够使用一个软件项目之前，必须先让该项目运行起来。这通常需要安装正确的语言运行时、系统软件包、构建工具和测试命令。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过检查代码仓库、编写安装脚本、运行脚本并修复产生的错误，实现了环境搭建的自动化。然而，这些智能体仍然遵循串行的试错循环：它们先尝试一条安装路径，等待缓慢的命令执行完毕，观察失败结果，然后才决定下一步尝试什么。由于环境相关的命令往往需要很长时间运行，这种串行工作流使得环境搭建速度缓慢，且每次只能探索一条路径。我们提出了SpecBuild，一个通过投机分叉机制实现更快、更高成功率的基于LLM的环境搭建系统。SpecBuild并行探索多条候选环境搭建分支，返回第一个成功配置完成的环境，并丢弃其余分支。它将这一设计应用于……
tldr: SpecBuild通过“投机分叉”机制将环境命令的漫长等待时间用于并行探索多条安装分支，返回首个成功配置的环境并丢弃其余分支，从而显著提升基于LLM的代码仓库环境搭建的速度与成功率。
en_tdlr: SpecBuild turns idle wait time into parallel exploration through speculative forking—exploring multiple setup branches concurrently and returning the first successfully committed environment—making LLM-based repository environment setup faster and more successful.
